title: Automatically Building Machine-Checked Assurance Cases from C Codebases to Requirements
title_cn: 从 C 代码库自动构建到需求的可机器核验保证案例
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in automating interactive theorem proving, yet verification of real-world C codebases requires more than discharging individual proof goals. The task involves jointly constructing expressive function specifications and their proofs, and ensuring that library interfaces compose along intended call sequences even without a designated client. This paper presents CCV, an LLM-assisted framework for building machine-checked assurance cases: structured, auditable artifacts supporting the claim that a C codebase meets its intended requirements. To model intended cross-interface use in open libraries, CCV constructs an interface protocol that exposes permitted call sequences and resource assumptions for review, with a conditional safety guarantee under verified contracts and caller obligations. CCV coordinates two complementary phases: (i) requirement-guided analysis and bottom-up construction of candidate specifications and protocols; and (ii) modular proof construction with feedback that revises the specifications and proofs. Implemented using VST in Rocq, CCV verifies memory safety and leak freedom for all 299 function definitions across six C benchmarks, including industrial cryptographic components, with less than one person-day of reported human effort per benchmark. The guarantees depend on disclosed contracts and assumptions; human review supplies the conformance judgments connecting the formal artifacts to the intended requirements.
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）在自动化交互式定理证明方面已展现潜力，但对真实 C 代码库的验证不仅仅是解决单个证明目标。该任务涉及联合构造富有表达力的函数规约及其证明，并确保库接口即便没有指定客户端，也能沿着预期调用序列进行组合。本文提出 CCV，一种由 LLM 辅助、用于构建可机器核验的保证案例（machine-checked assurance cases）的框架：一种结构化、可审计的制品，用以支撑「某 C 代码库满足其预期需求」这一主张。为对开放库中预期的跨接口使用进行建模，CCV 构造一个接口协议，暴露允许的调用序列和资源假设供审查，并在已验证的契约与调用者义务下给出一个条件安全保证。CCV 协调两个互补阶段：(i) 需求引导的分析与候选规约和协议的自底向上构造；(ii) 带反馈的模块化证明构造，用以修订规约与证明。在 Rocq 中以 VST 实现，CCV 为六个 C 基准（含工业密码学组件）中全部 299 个函数定义验证了内存安全和无泄漏，每个基准报告的人工投入不到一人日。这些保证依赖于所披露的契约与假设；人工审查提供将形式化制品连接到预期需求的一致性判断。
summary_cn: CCV 用 LLM 协同生成函数规约与证明，并建模跨接口调用协议，在 Rocq+VST 上为 6 个 C 基准（含工业密码组件）299 个函数全部验证了内存安全与无泄漏，每基准人工投入不到一人日。
objective_summary: 提出 CCV，LLM 辅助的框架用 VST/Rocq 为 C 代码构建机器可核查的保证案例，联合生成函数规约与证明；在 6 个 C 基准共 299 个函数定义上验证内存安全与无泄漏，每个基准人力少于一人日。
evidence_note: 6 个 C 基准 299 函数全部通过验证，含工业密码组件，但基准数量少且无与其他框架的量化对比。
novelty_note: 联合构造规约、接口协议与证明，面向开放库无指定客户端的跨接口使用，超出单一证明目标的 LLM 验证。
scope: C 代码库的内存安全与无泄漏，基于 VST in Rocq，6 个基准含工业密码组件。
limitations: 保证依赖人工披露的 contracts 与 caller 义务，且需要人工审核连接形式制品与意图需求。

title: Leveraging Game-Based Platform to Teach Code Refactoring: An Experience with Refactoria
title_cn: 借助游戏化平台教授代码重构：Refactoria 的课堂实验
abstract: Refactoring is the art of improving the internal structure of the code without altering its external behavior. Because of the topic's significance, several teaching methods and strategies have been proposed in the literature. However, skills in identifying and refac- toring code smells come from training and experience, and a lack of motivation may hinder developers' adoption of refactoring tools. In this paper, we discuss the results of an experiment in the classroom that involved performing various refactoring activities to remove antipatterns using Refactoria, an innovative game-based tool that supports the acquisition of code smell and refactoring concepts. The players play as an expert chef with their sidekick Watson the Whiskbot to refactor Watson's instructions into efficient, readable, and easily maintainable code. We present an experiment with 30 student developers. In particular, we study the perception, effectiveness, and usefulness of gamification for engaging developers in code smell identification and refactoring. Our evaluation indicates a high perceived usefulness among students, and participants reported that Refactoria facilitated their understanding of the refactoring concepts.
abstract_cn: 重构是在不改变代码外部行为的前提下改进其内部结构的艺术。由于该主题的重要性，文献中已经提出了多种教学方法与策略。然而，识别和重构 code smell 的技能来自训练与经验，缺乏动机可能会阻碍开发者采用重构工具。本文讨论了一项课堂实验的结果，实验让学生使用 Refactoria 执行多种重构活动以移除反模式——Refactoria 是一个创新的游戏化工具，用于辅助掌握 code smell 与重构概念。玩家扮演一位资深厨师，与其小助手 Watson the Whiskbot 一同将 Watson 的指令重构为高效、可读、易维护的代码。我们开展了一项针对 30 名学生开发者的实验。具体而言，我们研究了游戏化在促使开发者投入 code smell 识别与重构方面的感知度、有效性与有用性。评估结果表明学生的感知有用性较高，参与者反馈 Refactoria 有助于他们理解重构概念。
summary_cn: 在课堂上用游戏化工具 Refactoria 让 30 名学生扮演厨师重构 Watson 的「菜谱」，报告显示学生对工具的感知有用性较高，有助于理解重构概念。
objective_summary: 介绍游戏化工具 Refactoria（厨师 + Watson 助手设定）教授代码坏味与重构，并在 30 名学生开发者的课堂实验中测量感知有用性、有效性与参与度，报告学生主观评价较高。
evidence_note: 仅 30 名学生的单组课堂实验，无对照组或统计检验，主要依赖主观问卷评价。
novelty_note: 将游戏化应用于重构教学并提出具体叙事设定，但 refactoring 教学工具与 gamification 方向已有工作。
scope: 课堂环境、30 名学生开发者，针对代码坏味识别与重构概念的学习。
limitations: 样本小且无对照组，结论为学生自报感知，缺乏学习效果客观测量与长期保留验证。

title: Learning When and How to Intervene: A Hindsight-Distilled Sentinel for Coding Agents
title_cn: 学习何时与如何介入：面向编程 agent 的事后蒸馏哨兵 HiSentinel
abstract: Coding agents solve repository-level tasks through sequences of actions, where a single erroneous action can misdirect subsequent decisions and increase recovery costs. Existing approaches use execution feedback for recovery or specialized checks to block errors, but deciding before execution whether intervention will benefit eventual task completion remains challenging. To address this challenge, we propose HiSentinel, a hindsight-distillation framework that trains lightweight 0.6B and 1.7B sentinels to select pre-execution interventions aimed at improving task completion rather than correcting every imperfect action. A privileged teacher uses recorded execution outcomes as evidence for intervention judgments, which are distilled into a causal student that receives only the pre-action context and proposed action. Beyond identifying whether and when to intervene, the sentinel must also provide actionable feedback that helps the coding agent recover or obtain necessary human input. To support these capabilities, we introduce SWE-Intervene, an action-level dataset constructed from software-engineering trajectories that annotates whether an action should be allowed, autonomously redirected, or paused for human assistance, together with corresponding intervention feedback. Across SWE-bench Verified Mini and Ask or Assume, HiSentinel consistently improves task completion across Sentinel scales and coding-agent families, with gains of up to 14% and 10%, respectively, while maintaining competitive token consumption. These results demonstrate that lightweight pre-execution intervention can effectively prevent error propagation and improve the reliability of autonomous coding agents.
abstract_cn: 编程 agent 通过一系列动作解决仓库级任务，其中单个错误动作可能误导后续决策并增加恢复成本。现有方法利用执行反馈进行恢复，或用专门检查来拦截错误，但在执行前判断某次介入是否对最终任务完成有益仍具挑战。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 HiSentinel，一个事后蒸馏框架，用于训练 0.6B 和 1.7B 的轻量 sentinel，使其选择面向任务完成的预执行介入，而不是去纠正每一个不完美的动作。一个「特权教师」利用记录的执行结果作为介入判断的证据，并将这些判断蒸馏到一个「因果学生」中，学生仅接收预动作上下文与拟执行动作。除了识别是否以及何时介入之外，sentinel 还必须给出可操作的反馈，帮助编程 agent 恢复或获取必要的人类输入。为支持这些能力，我们引入 SWE-Intervene，一个动作级数据集，构建自软件工程轨迹，为每个动作标注应被放行、自主改向还是暂停以求助人工，并附上对应的介入反馈。在 SWE-bench Verified Mini 和 Ask or Assume 上，HiSentinel 在不同 sentinel 规模与编程 agent 家族上一致地提升任务完成率，最高分别提升 14% 与 10%，同时保持有竞争力的 token 消耗。这些结果表明，轻量的预执行介入能够有效防止错误传播，并提升自主编程 agent 的可靠性。
summary_cn: 提出 HiSentinel：用「特权教师基于执行结果判断是否介入」蒸馏出 0.6B/1.7B 的轻量 sentinel，在预执行阶段决定放行/改向/求助；在 SWE-bench Verified Mini 与 Ask or Assume 上任务完成率最高提升 14% 与 10%。
institution: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
objective_summary: 提出 HiSentinel，用 hindsight 蒸馏训练 0.6B/1.7B 哨兵模型做执行前干预决策，并构建 SWE-Intervene 动作级数据集；在 SWE-bench Verified Mini 与 Ask or Assume 上任务完成率分别最多提升 14% 和 10%。
evidence_note: 跨 SWE-bench Verified Mini 与 Ask or Assume 两个数据集、多种 agent 家族与两种模型规模对比，但未提统计检验。
novelty_note: 将执行前干预判定作为独立哨兵任务，用 hindsight 教师蒸馏到因果学生，并区分允许/重定向/暂停三类动作。
scope: SWE-bench Verified Mini 与 Ask or Assume 任务上的 coding agent，哨兵规模 0.6B/1.7B。
limitations: 依赖 hindsight 教师的轨迹标注质量；评测仅限 SWE 场景，未覆盖更广泛领域。

title: DoGBench: Can Agents Meet Expert Standards for User-Facing Documentation?
title_cn: DoGBench：agent 能否达到专家级用户文档的标准？
abstract: We introduce DoGBENCH (Documentation Generation Benchmark), to our knowledge, the first benchmark for generating and maintaining real user-facing software documentation. It asks whether an agent can produce documentation that experienced technical writers would accept in review. The benchmark contains 292 items from open source projects, including Helm, PostHog, and Mautic. Each item gives the agent a pre-change repository and a trigger, such as a code pull request or a reported documentation gap. The agent must first decide whether the documentation needs an update. For items that need one, the agent must produce an acceptable patch in one attempt. For items that do not need updates, the agent must abstain. Task-specific rubrics, validated with project maintainers, score each patch on accuracy, completeness, reader guidance, placement, and repository conventions. The composite score combines patch quality with correct abstention, and a score of 100 means an agent meets every requirement for the task. Scores should not be interpreted as a percentage of an expert's capability. We evaluated seven agents. The highest-scoring agent reached 47.3 out of 100 on the 117-item held-out split. In a separate audit of 1,267 patches, the most common failure modes were task-completion gaps (45.5%), technical inaccuracies (36.6%), and incomplete conceptual or reference coverage (32.5%). Analysis of the corresponding trajectories identified three key patterns associated with these failures: (1) describing interfaces without examining how readers use them (36.0%), (2) missing decisive evidence and filling the gaps with plausible assumptions (33.1%), and (3) stopping after finding the first plausible documentation surface and leaving other affected pages stale (30.1%).
abstract_cn: 我们提出 DoGBENCH（Documentation Generation Benchmark），据我们所知这是首个用于生成和维护真实面向用户的软件文档的 benchmark。它询问 agent 是否能够产出有经验的技术写手在评审中会接受的文档。该 benchmark 包含来自开源项目的 292 个条目，涉及 Helm、PostHog 和 Mautic 等。每个条目给 agent 一个变更前的仓库和一个触发器，例如代码 pull request 或已报告的文档缺口。agent 必须首先判断文档是否需要更新；对需要更新的条目，agent 必须在一次尝试中产出可接受的补丁；对不需要更新的条目，agent 必须弃权。任务专属的评分准则在项目维护者参与下得到验证，对每个补丁从准确性、完整性、读者引导、位置摆放和仓库约定五个维度打分。综合分将补丁质量与正确弃权结合起来，100 分意味着 agent 满足任务的全部要求；分数不应被解读为专家能力的百分比。我们评估了七个 agent，在 117 项的留出集上得分最高的 agent 只达到 47.3 分（满分 100）。在对 1,267 个补丁的单独审计中，最常见的失败模式为任务未完成的缺口（45.5%）、技术不准确（36.6%）以及概念或参考覆盖不完整（32.5%）。对相应轨迹的分析识别出与这些失败相关的三种关键模式：（1）描述接口时不去考察读者如何使用它们（36.0%）；（2）缺乏决定性证据并以貌似合理的假设填补空缺（33.1%）；（3）在找到第一个看似合理的文档落点后就停下，使其他受影响的页面被遗漏陈旧（30.1%）。
summary_cn: 推出 DoGBench，含 Helm/PostHog/Mautic 等开源项目的 292 个任务，要求 agent 既能更新文档也能对不需更新者弃权；最强 agent 在 117 项留出集上仅得 47.3/100，审计 1267 个补丁揭示任务未完成（45.5%）、技术错误（36.6%）等主要失败模式。
objective_summary: 提出 DoGBench 基准，包含来自 Helm、PostHog、Mautic 等开源项目的 292 个用户面向文档生成任务，评测 7 个 agent，最高分 47.3/100（117 项留出集），并对 1267 个 patch 做审计发现任务完成缺口占 45.5%、技术不准确 36.6%。
evidence_note: 292 任务 + 117 留出集，评估 7 个 agent 并审计 1267 patch，有 rubric 校验，但缺统计检验。
novelty_note: 声称是首个面向真实用户文档生成与维护的基准，并包含是否需更新的 abstain 决策。
scope: 开源项目用户面向文档（Helm/PostHog/Mautic 等），任务由代码 PR 或文档缺口触发，单次 patch 评分。
limitations: 分数不等于专家能力百分比；最高 agent 仅 47.3/100，说明任务难度高且评分口径有限。

title: COMPASS: Predicting the Relationship of Multiple Patches for Vulnerabilities with LLMs
title_cn: COMPASS：用 LLM 预测漏洞多补丁之间的关系
abstract: Modern software heavily relies on code reuse, so upstream vulnerability fixes do not automatically propagate to downstream codebases. Downstream maintainers must manually adopt patches to eliminate known risks. In practice, a single vulnerability often corresponds to multiple patches, which greatly complicates downstream patch adoption because different patch relationships imply different adoption strategies. To address this challenge, we first manually inspect large-scale multi-patch vulnerabilities (about 1K) in the real world and interview experienced developers, summarizing six typical types of patch relationships, i.e., Merge, Mirror, Better Solution, Fixing-of-Fixing, Collaboration, and Separation. Based on these observations, we propose COMPASS, an automated approach that predicts the relationships of multiple vulnerability patches with large language models. Given a CVE as input, COMPASS follows a four-phase pipeline that (i) identifies the patch group and pre-scans explicit relationships, (ii) performs individual patch analysis, (iii) infers relationship instances via a hierarchy-guided prompt, and (iv) validates completeness and consistency of the inferred results. As output, COMPASS reports the predicted relationships within the patch group and visualizes them as a relationship graph. We evaluate COMPASS on a benchmark of 300 multi-patch CVEs and compare it against mainstream learning-based and LLM baselines. Results show that our method achieves strong and consistent prediction effectiveness and outperforms SOTA by 85.04% on average. We publicly release an online querying website to support community reuse of patch relationships knowledge: https://patch-relation.com.
abstract_cn: 现代软件大量依赖代码复用，因此上游漏洞修复不会自动传播到下游代码库，下游维护者必须手动采纳补丁以消除已知风险。实践中，单一漏洞往往对应多个补丁，这极大地复杂化了下游补丁采纳，因为不同的补丁关系意味着不同的采纳策略。为应对这一挑战，我们首先人工审查了现实世界中大规模的多补丁漏洞（约 1K）并访谈了经验丰富的开发者，归纳出六种典型的补丁关系类型，即 Merge、Mirror、Better Solution、Fixing-of-Fixing、Collaboration 与 Separation。基于这些观察，我们提出 COMPASS，一种借助 large language model 自动预测多个漏洞补丁之间关系的方法。给定一个 CVE 作为输入，COMPASS 遵循四阶段流水线：(i) 识别补丁组并预扫描显式关系；(ii) 执行单补丁分析；(iii) 通过层级引导的 prompt 推断关系实例；(iv) 验证推断结果的完整性与一致性。作为输出，COMPASS 报告该补丁组内预测出的关系，并将其可视化为关系图。我们在包含 300 个多补丁 CVE 的 benchmark 上评估 COMPASS，并与主流的基于学习与基于 LLM 的基线进行比较。结果显示我们的方法达到了强且一致的预测效果，平均比 SOTA 高出 85.04%。我们公开发布了一个在线查询网站，以支持社区复用补丁关系知识：https://patch-relation.com。
summary_cn: 在约 1K 实际多补丁漏洞和开发者访谈基础上归纳出 Merge、Mirror、Better Solution、Fixing-of-Fixing、Collaboration、Separation 六类补丁关系；提出四阶段 LLM 流水线 COMPASS，在 300 个多补丁 CVE 基准上平均比 SOTA 高 85.04%。
objective_summary: 人工检查约 1K 个多补丁漏洞并访谈开发者，归纳合并/镜像/更好方案/修修复/协作/分离 6 类补丁关系，提出 COMPASS 四阶段 LLM 流水线从 CVE 预测关系并可视化。在 300 个多补丁 CVE 基准上相比学习与 LLM 基线平均提升 85.04%。
evidence_note: 300 多补丁 CVE 基准 + 学习与 LLM 基线对比，平均提升 85.04%，无显著性检验
novelty_note: 首次系统化多补丁 6 类关系（合并/镜像/更好方案等）并以 LLM 流水线自动预测
scope: 300 个多补丁 CVE，6 类补丁关系的自动预测与可视化
limitations: 评估依赖 300 题自建基准；LLM 推理一致性与跨语言泛化未全验证

title: Trust Is Not a Score: Runtime Assurance Contracts for High-Risk AI Agents
title_cn: Trust Is Not a Score：面向高风险 AI agent 的运行时保证合约
abstract: Benchmarks, audits, and agent protocols describe performance, permissions, and repair, but not how observed evidence should change an agent's authority during a consequential task. We call this the assurance-transition gap. We propose a Runtime Assurance Contract (RAC), a policy-level formal schema binding autonomy boundaries, component eligibility, evidence state, transition policy, human-review capacity, and non-compensatory gates. Under RAC, soft metrics may inform routing, whereas a failed or unknown mandatory gate forces retry, switch, escalation, deferral, or stop; aggregate performance cannot authorize action. We define the contract, an evidence record, a permission rule, and five invariants, and illustrate them in clinical, industrial, and judicial failure probes. We then report a deterministic failure-injection study in agentic coding: 280 constructed cases evaluated by a gate conjunction, a score-only rule, and a restricted protocol baseline. At the published example weights and threshold, the score rule admits 80 of 100 block-required injections and all 40 review-required injections. Tuned in hindsight, it matches the conjunction on this corpus. For positive weights, a positive threshold, binary risk signals, zero-signal controls, and an injected case firing each signal alone, we show that exact agreement holds if and only if the threshold does not exceed the smallest weight. A separate set of 18 hand-authored traces checks version-pinned evidence and review transitions against simpler policy variants. In a further prospective synthetic holdout of 24 episodes, two blinded LLM judges assign identical labels to all 72 action attempts; RAC and a separately implemented full stateful baseline both match these labels. These studies test mechanisms on synthetic cases; they establish neither deployed safety nor cross-domain effectiveness.
abstract_cn: 基准、审计和 agent 协议描述了性能、权限与修复，但没有描述所观察到的证据应如何在一次有后果的任务中改变 agent 的权限。我们称之为保证迁移鸿沟（assurance-transition gap）。我们提出 Runtime Assurance Contract (RAC)，一种策略层面的形式化模式，将自主性边界、组件资格、证据状态、迁移策略、人工审查容量以及不可补偿的门控绑定在一起。在 RAC 下，软指标可用于路由，而失败或未知的强制门控会强制触发重试、切换、升级、推迟或停止；聚合性能不能授权行动。我们定义了该合约、证据记录、权限规则与五条不变量，并在临床、工业与司法失败探针中加以说明。随后我们在 agent 式编程中报告了一项确定性故障注入研究：280 个构造的案例分别由门控合取、仅凭分数的规则以及一个受限协议基线进行评估。在所公布的样例权重与阈值下，分数规则放行了 100 个要求阻断的注入中的 80 个，以及全部 40 个要求审查的注入。事后调参后，它在该语料上与合取规则表现一致。对于正权重、正阈值、二元风险信号、零信号对照以及单独触发每个信号的注入案例，我们证明：当且仅当阈值不超过最小权重时，才有精确一致性。另一组 18 条手写轨迹针对若干更简策略变体核验了版本锚定的证据与审查迁移。在进一步的 24 回合前瞻合成留出集上，两位盲评 LLM 评审员对全部 72 次动作尝试给出一致标签；RAC 与一个独立实现的完整状态式基线均与这些标签相符。这些研究是在合成案例上检验机制；它们既未证明部署安全性，也未证明跨领域有效性。
summary_cn: 提出 Runtime Assurance Contract (RAC)，用不可补偿门控替代单一分数授权；agent 编程 280 例故障注入上，仅凭分数的规则放行了 100 例阻断类注入中的 80 例与全部 40 例审查类注入。
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Ancillary files: decision log, executable transition model, LLM-labelled synthetic holdout. Synthetic mechanism study; no deployment claim
objective_summary: 提出运行时保证合约 RAC，用自治边界、组件资格、证据记录、许可规则与 5 条不变量将代理授权形式化，并引入非补偿式门限。在 280 个构造用例中，分数规则允入 100 条「应拦截」注入中的 80 条和全部 40 条「需复核」注入；再在 18 条手写轨迹和 24 条合成留出集上 2 个 LLM 评判对 72 次动作完全一致。
evidence_note: 280 构造 + 18 手写轨迹 + 24 合成留出，全部为合成用例，无真实部署数据
novelty_note: 将非补偿式门限引入代理权限控制，与基于聚合分数的信任路由分离
scope: 合成构造的编码代理场景；RAC 策略级形式化与 5 条不变量
limitations: 作者自陈仅为合成机理研究，未证明部署安全性或跨域有效性

title: Aletheia: Permission-Minimality Testing for Coding-Agent Rules
title_cn: Aletheia：面向编程 agent 规则的权限最小化测试
abstract: Repository instruction files guide coding agents, but also expose them to prompt injection. Malicious rules can request credential access or data transfer while the agent produces a correct patch. We present Aletheia, a framework for permission-minimality testing. Aletheia translates requested authority into a typed language and synthesizes executable sandbox configurations. It runs the unchanged rule and task under full permissions and independent restrictions that remove one permission at a time. Passing independent functional tests under strictly reduced authority provides a dispensability witness, which Aletheia interprets against task context to diagnose suspicious requests. We formalize synthesis and the conditions connecting witnesses to enforced restrictions. On a shared refactoring task, Aletheia executes and detects all 314 AIShellJack attack inputs, with no alarms on five benign templates. Among 80 manually verified benign GHAgentFiles rules, it raises three false positives (3.75%).
abstract_cn: 仓库指令文件（repository instruction files）指导编程 agent，但也使其暴露于 prompt injection。恶意规则可以在 agent 产出正确补丁的同时请求凭据访问或数据传输。我们提出 Aletheia，一个用于权限最小化测试的框架。Aletheia 将请求的权限翻译为一种有类型的语言，并合成可执行的沙箱配置。它在完整权限下、以及每次移除一个权限的独立受限条件下运行未经修改的规则与任务。在严格削减的权限下通过独立的功能测试即构成可弃性证据（dispensability witness），Aletheia 结合任务上下文解读该证据以诊断可疑请求。我们形式化了合成过程以及连接证据与所施加限制的条件。在一个共享的 refactoring 任务上，Aletheia 执行并检出了全部 314 条 AIShellJack 攻击输入，对五个良性模板零告警。在 80 条人工核验过的良性 GHAgentFiles 规则中，它触发了 3 条假阳性（3.75%）。
summary_cn: Aletheia 将规则请求的权限翻译为有类型语言并合成沙箱，用「移除单一权限仍能通过功能测试」的可弃性证据定位可疑请求；检出全部 314 条 AIShellJack 攻击，80 条良性 GHAgentFiles 规则上假阳 3.75%。
objective_summary: 提出 Aletheia，针对编码代理规则文件的权限最小化测试框架：把请求权限翻译为类型语言并合成沙箱配置，逐一撤权复测以得到「可省性见证」。在共享重构任务上检出全部 314 条 AIShellJack 攻击输入、5 个良性模板零误报；80 条经人工核验的 GHAgentFiles 良性规则中产生 3 条误报（3.75%）。
evidence_note: 314 攻击输入 100% 检出 + 80 真实良性规则 3.75% 误报，但仅 1 个重构任务
novelty_note: 以撤权复测与「可省性见证」做权限最小化检测，不依赖风险分类器
scope: 仓库指令规则文件；共享重构任务下的 AIShellJack 与 GHAgentFiles
limitations: 仅在单一重构任务上评估；对多类任务与大规模仓库的泛化未验证

title: Self-Spec Verifiable Code Generation
title_cn: Self-Spec 可验证代码生成：VeriCodeBench 与 CodeNova
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) may generate unreliable code on corner cases missed by testing, while formal verification can provide machine-checkable guarantees. Recently, researchers have proposed several benchmarks to evaluate the capabilities of LLMs in generating formally verifiable code, where LLMs need to formulate formal specifications, generate the corresponding code, and verify its correctness. However, existing benchmarks have two key limitations: (I) They primarily evaluate specification and code generation stage-wise, with code generation typically conditioned on an oracle specification. This setup overlooks whether strong stage-wise performance translates into end-to-end success. (II)They mainly focus on a single proof-oriented language and mathematically structured tasks, offering limited coverage of tasks common in software development. In this paper, we introduce VeriCodeBench, a benchmark for self-spec verifiable code generation, where the LLM relies solely on its own generated specification and code throughout the entire process. VeriCodeBench contains 400 language-native problems across C, Java, Rust, and Python, covering practical concerns in software development. We evaluate specification coverage, code validity, and joint problem-level success. We further introduce CodeNova to enhance the capabilities of LLMs in self-spec verifiable code generation. CodeNova makes requirements explicit through constraint-guided specification and uses verifier feedback to guide targeted implementation repairs. Experimental results reveal that self-generated specifications remain a major bottleneck, while providing more sophisticated specifications may not necessarily lead to higher verification success rates. CodeNova substantially improves performance across all evaluation metrics, enabling Claude Sonnet 5 to achieve the strongest results under the self-spec protocol.
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）在测试遗漏的边界情形上可能生成不可靠的代码，而形式化验证能够提供机器可核查的保证。近期，研究者们提出了多个 benchmark 来评估 LLM 在生成可形式化验证代码方面的能力，其中 LLM 需要给出形式化规约、生成相应代码并验证其正确性。然而现有 benchmark 存在两点关键局限：（I）它们主要分阶段评估规约与代码生成，并且代码生成通常以 oracle 规约为条件；这种设定忽视了分阶段的强表现是否能转化为端到端的成功。（II）它们主要关注单一的面向证明的语言和数学结构化的任务，对软件开发中常见任务的覆盖有限。本文中，我们引入 VeriCodeBench，一个 self-spec 可验证代码生成的 benchmark，LLM 在整个过程中只能依赖自己生成的规约与代码。VeriCodeBench 包含跨 C、Java、Rust、Python 四种语言原生的 400 个问题，覆盖软件开发中的实际关切点。我们评估规约覆盖率、代码有效性以及问题级的联合成功率。我们进一步提出 CodeNova 以提升 LLM 在 self-spec 可验证代码生成上的能力：CodeNova 通过约束引导的规约使需求显式化，并利用验证器反馈引导有针对性的实现修复。实验结果揭示：自生成规约仍是主要瓶颈，而提供更复杂的规约未必带来更高的验证成功率；CodeNova 在所有评估指标上都显著改善了性能，使 Claude Sonnet 5 在 self-spec 协议下取得最强结果。
summary_cn: 提出 VeriCodeBench，覆盖 C/Java/Rust/Python 的 400 道题目，要求 LLM 全流程只用自己生成的规约与代码；配套方法 CodeNova 用约束引导规约和验证器反馈修复，使 Claude Sonnet 5 在 self-spec 协议下取得最佳结果，并揭示自生成规约仍是主要瓶颈。
objective_summary: 提出 VeriCodeBench，含 C/Java/Rust/Python 共 400 道面向软件开发的可验证代码题，并提出 CodeNova 方法通过约束引导规范和基于验证器反馈的定向修复。实验显示自生成规范仍是主要瓶颈，且更复杂的规范未必提高验证成功率，CodeNova 全指标提升并使 Claude Sonnet 5 在自规范协议下取得最佳结果。
evidence_note: 400 题跨 C/Java/Rust/Python 四语言，多 LLM 评估规范/代码/联合三维度
novelty_note: 从阶段式评估转为端到端自规范协议，覆盖 4 门主流语言而非证明导向语言
scope: C/Java/Rust/Python 共 400 题，端到端自规范-代码-验证协议
limitations: 自生成规范仍是主要瓶颈；更复杂规范未必提高验证成功率

title: EngramBench: A Capability-Grounded Benchmark for Skill-Evolution Harnesses
title_cn: EngramBench：面向技能演化 harness 的能力对齐 benchmark
abstract: While large language models have achieved remarkable success in isolated code generation, authentic software engineering requires sustained reasoning, complex state management, and continuous cross-domain abstraction. However, current evaluations of skill evolution in autonomous agents suffer from a critical identifiability problem: they structurally confound genuine capability abstraction with rote solution leakage (i.e., copying highly similar code from historical training data). To resolve this, we introduce EngramBench, a rigorous, capability-grounded benchmark governed by the strict axiom of capability overlap without solution overlap. Comprising 30 diverse learning tasks and 13 unseen transfer tasks, EngramBench challenges agents to navigate interactive, multi-hour development cycles driven by LLM-simulated users. Our extensive evaluation across 48 multi-hour execution trajectories -- corroborated by human-expert validation -- reveals a profound insight into procedural memory. We demonstrate that static skill banks do not magically bypass the "last mile" of exact code implementation, which remains bottlenecked by the base model's inherent reasoning limits. However, they serve as an indispensable execution compass. By navigating agents away from catastrophic, token-heavy trial-and-error, genuine capability abstraction slashes redundant context bloat and reduces overall coding time by over 55%. Ultimately, EngramBench shifts the evaluation paradigm from trivial pattern matching to the verifiable measurement of deep, cross-domain capability transfer.
abstract_cn: 尽管 large language model 在孤立的代码生成上取得了显著成功，真实的软件工程却需要持续推理、复杂的状态管理以及持续的跨领域抽象。然而，当前对自主 agent 技能演化的评估存在严重的可识别性问题：它们在结构上把真正的能力抽象与机械的解答泄漏（即从历史训练数据中照抄高度相似的代码）混淆在一起。为解决这一问题，我们提出 EngramBench，一个严格的、能力对齐的 benchmark，受「能力重叠但解答不重叠」这一严格公理约束。EngramBench 包含 30 个多样化的学习任务和 13 个未见的迁移任务，挑战 agent 在由 LLM 模拟用户驱动的、交互式、多小时的开发周期中完成任务。我们在 48 条多小时执行轨迹上进行了广泛评估——并由人类专家验证佐证——揭示了关于程序性记忆的深刻洞见：我们证明静态技能库并不能神奇地绕过精确代码实现的「最后一公里」，这一环仍然受限于基座模型固有的推理能力；但是，它们可以作为不可或缺的「执行指南针」，通过把 agent 从灾难性的、token 密集的试错中引导出来，真正的能力抽象可以大幅削减冗余的上下文膨胀，使总体编码时间减少超过 55%。最终，EngramBench 把评估范式从琐碎的模式匹配转向对深层、跨领域能力迁移的可验证度量。
summary_cn: 针对现有技能演化评测把真实能力抽象与「从训练数据抄解」混为一谈的问题，提出遵循「能力重叠但解答不重叠」公理的 EngramBench，含 30 个学习任务与 13 个未见迁移任务；48 条多小时轨迹显示静态技能库无法突破基模的「最后一公里」，但能把总体编码时间削减 55% 以上。
institution: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen
objective_summary: 提出 EngramBench，含 30 个学习任务和 13 个未见迁移任务，由 LLM 模拟用户驱动多小时交互开发，并提出「能力重叠而非解法重叠」公理。在 48 条执行轨迹上评估并由专家验证，发现静态技能库不能绕过基础模型的实现瓶颈，但能把整体编码时间减少 55% 以上。
evidence_note: 48 条多小时轨迹 + 人工专家验证，任务 30+13，无统计检验且轨迹规模有限
novelty_note: 以「能力重叠而非解法重叠」为公理，区分真能力抽象与训练数据泄漏
scope: 30 个学习任务 + 13 个迁移任务，LLM 模拟用户驱动的多小时编码场景
limitations: 用户由 LLM 模拟而非真实开发者；轨迹仅 48 条且评估规模有限

title: Trustworthy Runtime Error Healing in Real-World Repositories: A Benchmark and Guardrail
title_cn: 真实仓库中可信的运行时错误自愈：一个基准与护栏
abstract: Runtime error healing lets a crashed program continue by generating code that repairs its live runtime state. Recent work shows that LLMs can generate such healing code, but it is evaluated only on small competition programs, and executing LLM-generated code inside a live process raises safety concerns that remain unaddressed. In this paper, we take LLM-based runtime healing toward practical use in real-world repositories. We first build HealBench, a benchmark of 265 runtime errors from 18 real-world repositories, each paired with a reference execution on the patched version. HealBench also provides a unified framework that lets LLM agents heal with cross-file context and live runtime state. We then design HealGuard, which requires healing code to be written in HealCore, an analyzable subset of Python, and uses static and dynamic taint analysis to check whether state changed by healing reaches operations protected by developers. We evaluate a dedicated healing method and three general coding agents with three backbone LLMs. The best setting resumes execution in 38.11% of instances and passes the target test in 28.68%, showing that existing agents can already heal a meaningful share of real repository-level crashes. However, among executions that pass, HealGuard flags 17.4% whose healing-changed state may reach a protected operation. On 684 controlled cases, HealGuard detects all unsafe cases, at the cost of a 68.42% false positive rate.
abstract_cn: 运行时错误自愈让崩溃的程序通过生成修复其运行时状态的代码得以继续执行。近期工作表明 LLM 能够生成这类自愈代码，但其评测仅在小型竞赛程序上进行，而在活跃进程内执行 LLM 生成的代码会带来尚未解决的安全隐患。本文将基于 LLM 的运行时自愈推向真实仓库中的实用阶段。我们首先构建了 HealBench，一个包含来自 18 个真实仓库的 265 个运行时错误的基准，每个错误都配有在已修补版本上的参考执行。HealBench 还提供了一个统一的框架，让 LLM agent 能够利用跨文件上下文和实时运行时状态进行自愈。随后我们设计了 HealGuard，它要求自愈代码必须用 HealCore（Python 的一个可分析子集）编写，并使用静态与动态污点分析来检查自愈所改变的状态是否会到达开发者保护的操作。我们评估了一种专门的自愈方法和三种通用编码 agent，搭配三种骨干 LLM。最佳设置能在 38.11% 的实例中恢复执行，并在 28.68% 的实例中通过目标测试，表明现有 agent 已经可以修复真实仓库级别崩溃的相当一部分。然而，在通过的执行中，HealGuard 标记出 17.4% 的案例，其自愈改变的状态可能会到达受保护的操作。在 684 个受控案例上，HealGuard 检出了所有不安全案例，代价是 68.42% 的假阳性率。
summary_cn: 构建了含 265 个真实仓库运行时错误的 HealBench 和 HealGuard 护栏；最佳设置恢复执行率 38.11%、通过目标测试率 28.68%，但 17.4% 通过案例被标记为可能不安全，护栏在 684 个受控案例上检出全部不安全情形但假阳性率 68.42%。
objective_summary: 发布 HealBench（18 个真实仓库 265 个运行时错误）和 HealGuard 守护机制（HealCore 可分析子集加静/动态污点分析）；在 3 代理 × 3 LLM 的设置下，最佳组合恢复执行 38.11%、通过目标测试 28.68%。HealGuard 对 684 个受控用例全部识别不安全，但假阳性率 68.42%。
evidence_note: 265 真实仓库错误 + 684 受控用例，3 代理 × 3 LLM 多设置评估，报告率与误报率
novelty_note: 首个仓库级运行时自愈基准，并以 HealCore 子集 + 污点分析做安全守护
scope: 18 个真实 Python 仓库的运行时错误；healing 代码限 HealCore 子集
limitations: HealGuard 假阳性率高达 68.42%；healing 代码受限于 HealCore 子集

title: From Verification Failures to Reusable Guidance for Coding Agents
title_cn: 从验证失败到编码 agent 的可复用指导
abstract: Coding agents need to establish that a program satisfies a specification and that the specification captures the requested behavior. We study how expert diagnosis of verification failures can become reusable guidance for this work. Our approach combines executable language definitions in the K framework with a kit of procedures for constructing specifications, repairing proofs, and auditing their adequacy. A human-guided development campaign on HumanEval, a benchmark of 164 Python programming tasks, achieves a 164/164 success rate with the semantics and the kit, measured by final AI audit Pass verdicts after two targeted repairs. To examine whether auditing detects problems that successful proofs leave unresolved, we construct 12 author-reviewed pairs of clean and defective packages. Every package passes its K proofs, and completed audits identify all defects and accept all clean packages. We then use KleverBench to test specification and proof construction for 31 programs with changed operator meanings. Comparisons with complete acceptance rules and equally long generic advice yield mixed results across two model and budget settings, motivating further work on selecting useful guidance within resource limits. Human-reviewed Optimism proofs establish expected pause reverts for six operations within declared input bounds under London semantics with unbounded gas. We report progress, difficulties, and lessons toward agents that deliver programs with checkable correctness arguments.
abstract_cn: 编码 agent 需要确立程序满足规约、且规约刻画了所请求的行为。我们研究专家对验证失败的诊断如何转化为这项工作的可复用指导。我们的方法将 K 框架中的可执行语言定义与一套构造规约、修复证明、审计其充分性的流程结合起来。我们在 HumanEval（164 个 Python 编程任务的基准）上进行了一次人类引导的开发活动，用上述语义与流程套件取得了 164/164 的成功率，衡量方式为经过两次有针对性修复后最终的 AI 审计 Pass 判定。为了检验审计是否能发现成功证明仍未暴露的问题，我们构造了 12 对由作者审阅的清洁包与缺陷包。每个包都通过了其 K 证明，而完成的审计识别出所有缺陷并接受了所有清洁包。随后我们用 KleverBench 测试了 31 个操作符含义被更改程序的规约与证明构造。与完整接受规则以及等长的通用建议相比，在两种模型与预算设定下结果喜忧参半，这促使进一步研究如何在资源限制内选择有用的指导。人工审阅的 Optimism 证明在声明的输入边界下，依据 London 语义、不限 gas，确立了六个操作预期会 pause revert。我们报告了朝着能交付具有可核查正确性论证的程序 agent 这一方向上的进展、困难和经验教训。
summary_cn: 用 K 框架可执行语义加上一套流程指导编码 agent 做规约构造与证明修复：在 HumanEval 164 任务上取得 164/164 成功率，在 12 对清洁/缺陷包上审计全部检出缺陷并全接受清洁包，KleverBench 上则结果喜忧参半。
objective_summary: 用 K 框架的可执行语义配合规范构造、证明修复与审计程序的手工套件，辅助编码代理生成带机器可检验证据的程序。在 HumanEval 164 题全部通过 AI 审计（含两次定向修复），12 对作者构造的干净/缺陷包全部被审计正确识别，KleverBench 31 题下与完整接受规则及通用建议对比结果混合。
evidence_note: HumanEval 164/164 + 12 作者构造对 + KleverBench 31 题，规模小且全程人类引导
novelty_note: 将 K 可执行语义与规范/证明/审计套件引入 LLM 代理工作流，强调可审计性
scope: HumanEval Python 164 题、KleverBench 31 题、Optimism 伦敦语义下 6 操作
limitations: 全流程人类引导；KleverBench 结果混合，依赖专家构造规范与证明

title: Approval Laundering: Systematizing Approval--Execution Binding Failures in AI Coding-Agent Harnesses
title_cn: Approval Laundering：AI 编程 agent harness 中批准—执行绑定失败的系统化研究
abstract: Modern AI coding-agent harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor) rest their security boundary on a largely unexamined assumption: that the action A a human approves is the same action A' the harness executes, where A is fixed by a stated policy for what a scope grant or session-scoped approval authorizes. We show this assumption fails systematically and reproducibly. We introduce Approval Laundering, a taxonomy of six failure modes by which a harness's enforcement mechanism silently substitutes A' for A after approval: Scope, Argument, Temporal, Tool, Delegation, and Semantic laundering. Unlike prior work that evaluates risk classifiers against static corpora or infers implicit authorization boundaries, we study credential-binding integrity: given an already-approved action, does the harness dispatch exactly that action? Instrumenting Claude Code's pre-execution mediation point (PreToolUse), we conduct a controlled, headless, repeated-measures study of all six classes (N=19-20 runs each), reporting a Bound-Gap Rate (BGR) with Wilson confidence intervals and inter-rater agreement (kappa=1.0). We prototype Approval Token, a keyed capability Hk(principal, agent_id, session_id, tool, arguments, scope, expiry) issued by a mediator that never returns the key to the agent, evaluated via paired before/after replay of 118 runs (McNemar's exact test). The token fully eliminates Delegation laundering and, for our seeded session-identity-mismatch construction, Temporal laundering (p<10^-5), but by design leaves Scope laundering unaffected and shows no significant reduction in Argument laundering (p=1): an honest negative result, since these two classes leave every recorded dispatch field unchanged, diverging one process level below what a field-only verifier can observe. We discuss implications for defenses that bind only at the tool-invocation boundary.
abstract_cn: 现代 AI 编程 agent harness（Claude Code、Codex CLI、Cursor）将其安全边界建立在一个基本未被审视的假设之上：人类批准的动作 A 与 harness 执行的动作 A' 是相同的，其中 A 由关于「某次 scope 授权或 session 级批准所授权范围」的既定策略所固定。我们表明这一假设会系统地、可复现地失败。我们引入 Approval Laundering，一个关于 harness 执行机制在批准后悄悄用 A' 替换 A 的六种失败模式的分类法：Scope、Argument、Temporal、Tool、Delegation 与 Semantic 洗白。与以往针对静态语料评估风险分类器或推断隐式授权边界的工作不同，我们研究的是凭据绑定完整性（credential-binding integrity）：给定一个已被批准的动作，harness 是否恰恰调度了那个动作？通过对 Claude Code 的执行前中介点（PreToolUse）进行插桩，我们对全部六类进行了受控、无头、重复测量研究（每类 N=19-20），报告了带 Wilson 置信区间的 Bound-Gap Rate (BGR) 以及评估者间一致性（kappa=1.0）。我们原型化了 Approval Token，一种带密钥的能力 Hk(principal, agent_id, session_id, tool, arguments, scope, expiry)，由一个从不将密钥返还给 agent 的中介签发；通过 118 次运行的配对前后重放（McNemar 精确检验）进行评估。该 token 完全消除了 Delegation 洗白，并对我们注入的 session-identity-mismatch 构造消除了 Temporal 洗白（p 小于 10 的负 5 次方），但按设计它对 Scope 洗白不起作用，对 Argument 洗白也未显示显著降低（p=1）：这是一个诚实的负面结果，因为这两类不会改变任何已记录的调度字段，分叉发生在仅能看字段的验证器所能观察到的层级之下一层。我们讨论了对仅在工具调用边界进行绑定的防御的启示。
summary_cn: 系统化给出 Claude Code/Codex CLI/Cursor 中 6 类「批准—执行解耦」失败模式，并在 Claude Code PreToolUse 上实测；提出带密钥的 Approval Token，完全消除 Delegation 洗白但对 Scope/Argument 洗白按设计失效（p=1）。
objective_summary: 提出 Approval Laundering 分类，刻画编码代理 harness 中「批准动作 ≠ 执行动作」的 6 类失败模式（Scope/Argument/Temporal/Tool/Delegation/Semantic），在 Claude Code 的 PreToolUse 挂点做 N=19-20 重复测量研究并报告 Wilson 置信区间与 κ=1.0。原型化 Approval Token 密钥能力，对 118 次配对实验用 McNemar 检验显示其完全消除 Delegation 泄露（p<10⁻⁵），但对 Scope/Argument 泄露无显著改善（p=1）。
evidence_note: 重复测量研究 N=19-20，Wilson CI、κ=1.0、McNemar 配对检验，样本规模较小
novelty_note: 首次把批准-执行绑定失败系统化为 6 类，关注凭证绑定完整性而非风险分类
scope: Claude Code 的 PreToolUse 中介点，6 类 Approval Laundering 失败模式
limitations: 仅在 Claude Code 一个 harness 上验证；Token 对 Scope/Argument 泄露无效

title: Doing More with Less Tokens: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Coding Agents
title_cn: 以更少 token 做更多事：面向高效编码 agent 的分层强化学习
abstract: Recently, coding agents have emerged as a dominant paradigm for real-world software engineering (SWE) scenarios, which solve complex tasks through multi-turn interactions with development environments. However, frequent interactions with environments would inevitably introduce substantial token overhead, leading to high usage costs and latency. Although recent studies have explored reducing token usage by context manipulation and interaction limits at inference time, these approaches focus on improving token efficiency while overlooking the risk of discarding task-relevant information, thus struggling to balance the trade-off between resolution rate and token efficiency. In this paper, we study a more general paradigm without suffering from the limitation, i.e., training token-efficient coding agents with promising resolution performance, which is a highly-practical yet less-explored problem. To this end, we reveal two core observations in SWE scenarios: i) Efficiency Variation: successful resolution could be achieved with fewer tokens; ii) Entropy Correlation: unproductive behaviors are associated with turn-level entropy. Motivated by observations, we propose a novel reinforcement learning framework, dubbed HERO. Specifically, HERO prioritizes task resolution over token efficiency during policy optimization and encourages efficient reasoning patterns at both trajectory and turn levels. Extensive experiments on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Multilingual demonstrate that HERO achieves a favorable trade-off between resolution rate and token efficiency compared with state-of-the-art coding agents and reinforcement learning methods.
abstract_cn: 近年来，编码 agent 已成为真实世界软件工程（SWE）场景的主导范式，它们通过与开发环境的多轮交互解决复杂任务。然而，与环境的频繁交互不可避免地引入大量 token 开销，带来高昂的使用成本与延迟。尽管近期研究已经探索通过上下文操控与推理时的交互次数限制来降低 token 使用量，但这些方法只着眼于提升 token 效率，忽视了丢弃任务相关信息的风险，因而难以在解决率与 token 效率之间取得平衡。本文研究一种不受此限制的更一般范式，即训练既具备 token 效率又有良好解决率表现的编码 agent，这是一个高度实用但探索较少的问题。为此，我们揭示了 SWE 场景中的两个核心观察：一、效率可变：成功的解决可以用更少的 token 达成；二、熵关联：无成效的行为与回合级的熵相关。受这些观察启发，我们提出一种新的强化学习框架，命名为 HERO。具体而言，HERO 在策略优化中将任务解决置于 token 效率之上，并在轨迹级与回合级同时鼓励高效的推理模式。在 SWE-bench Verified 与 SWE-bench Multilingual 上的大量实验表明，HERO 与最先进的编码 agent 及强化学习方法相比，取得了解决率与 token 效率之间更有利的权衡。
summary_cn: 提出 HERO 分层强化学习框架训练 token 高效的编码 agent，基于「效率可变」与「熵关联」两个观察，在 SWE-bench Verified 与 Multilingual 上取得解决率与 token 效率间更优的权衡。
objective_summary: 提出 HERO，一种分层强化学习框架，在策略优化中优先解题率，并在轨迹与回合两级鼓励高效推理模式。在 SWE-bench Verified 与 SWE-bench Multilingual 上，与 SOTA 编码代理及 RL 方法相比，报告在解题率与 token 效率之间取得有利权衡。
evidence_note: SWE-bench Verified 与 Multilingual 两基准、有 SOTA 对比，摘要未给出具体数值
novelty_note: 从推理期上下文裁剪改为训练期 RL 同时优化解题率与 token 效率
scope: SWE-bench Verified 与 Multilingual 两基准上的编码代理训练
limitations: 仅在 SWE-bench 基准上评估，缺乏真实开发任务与长期部署验证

title: Toward Quantum Software Automation: A Quantum-Aware Harness for LLM-Guided Evolution
title_cn: 迈向量子软件自动化：面向 LLM 引导演化的量子感知 harness
abstract: Quantum software is critical for improving the efficiency and reliability of scarce quantum hardware. However, its design still relies heavily on ad-hoc, handcrafted heuristics that are often suboptimal and quickly become obsolete as quantum hardware evolves. LLM-guided evolutionary search offers a promising way to automatically explore complex software designs, but existing search frameworks lack the quantum-specific support needed for efficient evolution: verification is expensive, feedback is sparse, and heterogeneous quantum programs require different optimization objectives. In this paper, we present QSA, a quantum-aware harness for LLM-guided evolutionary search toward automating quantum software design. QSA equips the search with three forms of quantum-specific guidance: an evolution-hardness-guided coreset and approximate scoring to reduce verification cost, static and snapshot analyses to provide fine-grained execution context, and task-specific rewards for compiler passes and runtime policies. We evaluate QSA on the IBM Quantum platform across three benchmark suites. For multiprogramming, QSA improves QPU utilization by 4.2%-9.5% and Hellinger fidelity by 15.2%-19.5% over the state of the art. For error mitigation, QSA reduces mitigation time by at least 96.8% while achieving comparable or better fidelity. These gains require only $6.9 in LLM API cost over 11.3 hours.
abstract_cn: 量子软件对于提升稀缺量子硬件的效率与可靠性至关重要。然而，其设计仍然严重依赖临时的、手工打造的启发式方法，这些方法往往次优，并会随着量子硬件的演进迅速过时。LLM 引导的演化搜索为自动探索复杂软件设计提供了一条有前景的路径，但现有搜索框架缺乏高效演化所需的量子特定支持：验证代价高、反馈稀疏、异构的量子程序需要不同的优化目标。本文提出 QSA，一个面向自动化量子软件设计的、用于 LLM 引导演化搜索的量子感知 harness。QSA 为搜索提供三种形式的量子特定指导：演化难度引导的 coreset 与近似打分以降低验证成本、静态与快照分析以提供细粒度的执行上下文，以及针对编译器 pass 与运行时策略的任务特定奖励。我们在 IBM Quantum 平台上基于三个基准套件评估 QSA。在多程序方面，QSA 将 QPU 利用率相对最新技术提升 4.2%-9.5%，Hellinger 保真度提升 15.2%-19.5%。在误差缓解方面，QSA 将缓解时间至少减少 96.8%，同时取得相当或更优的保真度。这些收益仅需 11.3 小时内 6.9 美元的 LLM API 费用。
summary_cn: 提出量子感知 harness QSA 为 LLM 引导的演化搜索提供三类量子特定指导，在 IBM Quantum 上使 QPU 利用率提升 4.2%-9.5%、Hellinger 保真度提升 15.2%-19.5%，并将误差缓解时间至少减少 96.8%，总成本 6.9 美元。
objective_summary: 提出 QSA，一个面向量子软件自动化的 LLM 演化搜索框架，加入演化难度引导的 coreset 近似评分、静态/快照分析和任务特定奖励。在 IBM Quantum 的三套基准上，相比 SOTA 把 QPU 利用率提升 4.2%-9.5%、Hellinger 保真度提升 15.2%-19.5%，错误缓解时间减少至少 96.8%，总 LLM 成本 6.9 美元 / 11.3 小时。
evidence_note: IBM Quantum 三套基准、与 SOTA 对比，报告多指标数值，但无显著性检验
novelty_note: 首次将 LLM 演化搜索与量子特定指导（coreset/静态分析/任务奖励）结合
scope: IBM Quantum 平台的多程序与错误缓解任务，共三套 benchmark
limitations: 仅在 IBM Quantum 一个平台评估，未验证其他量子硬件与开源 LLM 适配

title: PatchHolmes: Agentic Patch Retrieval via Listwise Selection
title_cn: PatchHolmes：基于 listwise 选择的 agent 式补丁检索
abstract: Patch retrieval, the task of finding the commit that fixes a known vulnerability, is the foundation of vulnerability management workflows, yet 60% to 63% of CVEs in the major advisory databases lack a patch link. We present PatchHolmes, a two-phase patch retrieval system that pairs a hybrid first-stage retriever with an agentic second-stage inspection loop. Unlike pointwise prior work that scores each candidate independently, the Phase 2 agent reads the top-100 listwise: it sees the full candidate list at once and selectively reads 3 to 10 commits through four budgeted tools before submitting a single best commit. On GitHubAD, PatchHolmes beats the pointwise binary classifier Favia by 25.34% Recall@1 and the retrieve-and-CoT baseline IRCoT by 31.40%, at one agent conversation per CVE versus Favia's ten; with the candidate set held identical, the agent adds 27.32% Recall@1 over taking the retriever's top candidate, and the same agent, transferred unchanged to PatchFinder_top10, lifts Recall@1 from PatchFinder's own top-1 pick (24.28%) to 39.86%. Swapping the LLM backbone within the Qwen family changes Recall@1 by under 1%, and a second model family (gpt-oss) stays far above the no-agent floor, so the gain comes from the listwise agent loop; the entire system runs on a frozen open-weight model over a local Git repository, without fine-tuning or external search APIs.
abstract_cn: 补丁检索（patch retrieval），即为已知漏洞找到其修复 commit 的任务，是漏洞管理工作流的基础，然而主要漏洞公告数据库中 60% 到 63% 的 CVE 都缺少补丁链接。我们提出 PatchHolmes，一个两阶段补丁检索系统，将一个混合的一阶段检索器与一个 agent 式的二阶段检查循环配对。与以往对每个候选独立打分的 pointwise 工作不同，Phase 2 的 agent 以 listwise 方式读取 top-100：它一次性看到完整候选列表，并通过四个预算工具选择性地读取 3 到 10 个 commit，然后提交单个最佳 commit。在 GitHubAD 上，PatchHolmes 以 25.34% 的 Recall@1 优势击败了 pointwise 二分类器 Favia，并以 31.40% 的优势击败了 retrieve-and-CoT 基线 IRCoT；每个 CVE 一次 agent 对话，而 Favia 需要十次。在候选集保持相同的条件下，agent 相较于直接采用检索器 top 候选获得 27.32% 的 Recall@1 提升；同一 agent 原样迁移到 PatchFinder_top10 上，将 Recall@1 从 PatchFinder 自身的 top-1 选择（24.28%）提升到 39.86%。在 Qwen 家族内更换 LLM 底座使 Recall@1 变化不足 1%，另一个模型家族（gpt-oss）也远高于无 agent 的下限，因此增益来自 listwise 的 agent 循环；整个系统运行在一个冻结的开权重模型之上，操作本地 Git 仓库，无需微调或外部搜索 API。
summary_cn: PatchHolmes 让 agent 一次性看 top-100 候选并选择性读 3-10 个 commit，GitHubAD 上 Recall@1 比 pointwise 的 Favia 高 25.34%、比 IRCoT 高 31.40%；换 Qwen 内不同底座差异不足 1%，增益来自 listwise agent 循环本身。
comment: Accepted at AACL-IJCNLP 2026. Code at this https URL
objective_summary: 提出 PatchHolmes 两阶段补丁检索：混合召回加代理 listwise 检查并以 4 种预算化工具选 3-10 个提交读。在 GitHubAD 上 Recall@1 比 Favia 高 25.34 比 IRCoT 高 31.40，同候选集下较取 top1 提高 27.32，Qwen 内换骨干波动小于 1，gpt-oss 跨族仍远高于无代理基线。
evidence_note: GitHubAD 多基线对比并在 Qwen 与 gpt-oss 两族骨干上做跨模型鲁棒检验
novelty_note: 把补丁检索第二阶段换成有预算工具的 listwise 代理，而非逐候选 pointwise
scope: 结论在 GitHubAD 与 PatchFinder_top10 候选集的 CVE 补丁检索
limitations: 依赖本地 Git 仓库与首阶段召回质量，仅覆盖 CVE 补丁定位场景

title: Adaptive-GEPA: Make Your Harness Fit Heterogeneous Requests
title_cn: Adaptive-GEPA：让你的 harness 适配异构请求
abstract: Reflective optimizers such as GEPA improve language model prompts from execution traces and evaluator feedback; full-program extensions can also rewrite tools and control flow. In practice, a user hands the same endpoint heterogeneous requests whose effective solutions require different tools, reasoning modes, and control flow. Optimizing one shared program leaves this division of work implicit in source-code search, while optimizing a separate program per request family fixes it beforehand. We introduce Adaptive-GEPA, which learns both how to divide requests and how to solve them. It evolves a router and a library of specialist programs under one search budget. The router's instructions, each specialist's description, and its program code are plain, human-readable text, edited from feedback. To combine branches, it aligns specialists by the requests they handle and inherits descriptions together with programs. On a fixed mixture of four task families, the reported Qwen3-8B run evolves four experts without supplying family labels to the router or reflection model; its routing matches the task partition on all 651 test requests. Its family-mean test score (x100) rises from 52.6 to 70.6, compared with 62.5 for GEPA's full-program adapter and 54.0 for GRPO at a nominal budget of 18,000 scored calls. These counts do not equate total compute. Figure 1 summarizes the learning curves, final test scores, and routing agreement.
abstract_cn: 类似 GEPA 的反思式优化器会从执行轨迹与评估器反馈中改进语言模型提示；其整程序扩展还能改写工具与控制流。实践中，用户向同一端点发送异构请求，其有效解决方案需要不同的工具、推理模式与控制流。优化单一共享程序会把这种分工隐式地留在源代码搜索里，而为每个请求家族优化一个独立程序则将其预先固化。我们提出 Adaptive-GEPA，它既学习如何划分请求，也学习如何解决它们。它在同一搜索预算下演化一个路由器与一个专家程序库。路由器的指令、每个专家的描述及其程序代码都是可读的纯文本，依据反馈进行编辑。为合并分支，它按专家处理的请求将其对齐，并将描述与程序一同继承。在包含四个任务家族的固定混合上，所报告的 Qwen3-8B 运行在不向路由器与反思模型提供家族标签的情况下演化出四个专家；其路由在全部 651 个测试请求上与任务划分完全匹配。其家族均值测试分（乘 100）从 52.6 升至 70.6，相比之下 GEPA 的 full-program 适配器为 62.5，GRPO 在 18,000 次打分调用的名义预算下为 54.0。这些计数并不等同于总计算量。图 1 总结了学习曲线、最终测试分数与路由一致性。
summary_cn: 提出 Adaptive-GEPA 在同一搜索预算下同时演化路由器与多个专家程序，Qwen3-8B 在 4 个任务家族共 651 个测试请求上路由完全匹配任务划分，家族均值测试分从 52.6 升至 70.6，优于 GEPA full-program 适配器的 62.5。
objective_summary: 提出 Adaptive-GEPA，在反思式优化下同时演化请求路由器与可读文本的专家程序库，分支合并按处理请求集对齐。在 Qwen3-8B 固定四任务族 651 请求测试上族均分从 52.6 升至 70.6，GEPA 为 62.5、GRPO 为 54.0，且路由与真实任务划分完全一致。

novelty_note: 把 GEPA 扩展为同时学习路由与解法，分支合并用请求对齐继承描述

limitations: 单模型单任务组合评估，作者注明调用计数不等于总计算

title: An Empirical Study of Architectural Shift from Traditional to AI-Enabled Simulink Controllers
title_cn: 从传统到 AI 使能的 Simulink 控制器架构迁移实证研究
abstract: Effective AI adoption in cyber-physical systems (CPS) depends on embedding design knowledge into engineering practice. Yet as AI-enabled components increasingly replace analytically derived control laws, this occurs without a systematic understanding of how controller architectures differ or remain similar across paradigms. We address this gap with an empirical study of traditional and AI-enabled Simulink controllers, guided by a literature-derived taxonomy of ten structural categories and nine functional roles. The study analyzes 62 real-world models spanning 8 controller types and 10 application domains, and surveys 13 practitioners, identifying three architectural tensions. First, subsystem organization dominates all controller structures regardless of paradigm, occupying 68-72% of controller footprint, while core control logic occupies minimal space. Second, AI-enabled controllers rely heavily on discrete dynamics and user-defined abstraction, categories largely absent from AI literature, exposing a gap between described and implemented architectures. Third, constraint enforcement blocks largely disappear from AI-enabled models despite practitioner expectations. This reveals a misalignment where safety mechanisms shift from explicit structure to implicit training-time artifacts, breaking traceability.
abstract_cn: 在信息物理系统（CPS）中有效采纳 AI 取决于将设计知识嵌入工程实践。然而，随着 AI 使能组件日益取代解析式推导的控制律，这种替代在缺乏对不同范式下控制器架构如何不同或相同的系统性理解下发生。我们通过一项针对传统与 AI 使能 Simulink 控制器的实证研究来填补这一空白，研究由文献推导出的包含十个结构类别与九种功能角色的分类法引导。该研究分析了 62 个真实世界模型，跨越 8 种控制器类型与 10 个应用领域，并调查了 13 位实践者，识别出三种架构张力。第一，子系统组织主导所有控制器结构，无论范式为何，占据控制器 68%-72% 的空间，而核心控制逻辑占用极少空间。第二，AI 使能控制器严重依赖离散动态与用户定义的抽象，这些类别在 AI 文献中大多缺席，暴露了描述架构与实现架构之间的差距。第三，约束执行块在 AI 使能模型中大量消失，尽管实践者有相应预期。这揭示了一种错位：安全机制从显式结构转移到隐式的训练时产物，可追溯性由此断裂。
summary_cn: 基于 62 个真实模型（8 种控制器类型、10 个应用域）与 13 位实践者调查，发现子系统组织占控制器 68%-72% 的空间、AI 使能控制器大量依赖离散动态与用户自定义抽象，而约束执行块基本消失，暴露安全机制从显式结构转移到隐式训练产物的可追溯性断裂。

title: MallocSan: A Memory Safety Tool for Native Closed-Source Applications
title_cn: MallocSan：面向原生闭源应用的内存安全工具
abstract: Memory-corruption errors remain a leading cause of high-impact vulnerabilities in C and C++ software. Deterministic detection, however, remains difficult to deploy: compiler-based sanitizers require source code and control of the build pipeline, hardware-assisted schemes depend on specific platforms, and dynamic binary translation can impose order-of-magnitude slowdowns. This paper presents MallocSan, a heap sanitizer for native, potentially closed-source x86-64 Linux applications that requires no source access, recompilation, or specialized hardware. MallocSan interposes on memory allocation through LD_PRELOAD and embeds an object identifier in the unused high bits of each protected pointer. Dereferencing the resulting noncanonical pointer faults at the offending instruction, which MallocSan decodes and patches at runtime so that subsequent executions perform per-object bounds checks entirely in userspace. Sites that cannot be patched fall back to in-handler emulation or single-stepping, while an optional profile-guided pass rewrites frequently executed residual sites offline. MallocSan also extends identity-based checking to vector gather/scatter instructions and supports policy-scoped coverage. Across seven SPEC CPU 2017 benchmarks, MallocSan outperforms Valgrind Memcheck on five, with a geometric-mean execution-time factor of 4.82x relative to native execution, compared with 18.55x for Memcheck, while preserving substantial parallel scaling on both evaluated multithreaded workloads: 644.nab_s and pigz. On the in-scope Juliet tests, MallocSan detects all seeded violations with no false reports on the good executions. It also detects heap-buffer errors in real-world applications, including a known one-byte overread in LibTIFF's tiffcrop utility.
abstract_cn: 内存损坏错误仍是 C 和 C++ 软件中高影响力漏洞的主要来源。然而确定性检测难以部署：基于编译器的 sanitizer 需要源码并掌控构建流水线，硬件辅助方案依赖特定平台，动态二进制翻译则可能带来一个数量级的性能下降。本文提出 MallocSan，一个针对原生、可能是闭源的 x86-64 Linux 应用的堆 sanitizer，无需访问源码、重新编译或特殊硬件。MallocSan 通过 LD_PRELOAD 拦截内存分配，并在每个受保护指针的未使用高位嵌入对象标识符。对结果非规范指针的解引用会在违例指令处触发错误，MallocSan 在运行时对其解码并打补丁，使后续执行完全在用户态执行按对象的边界检查。无法打补丁的位点会回落到处理器内模拟或单步执行，而可选的 profile-guided 过程会离线重写频繁执行的残余位点。MallocSan 还将基于身份的检查扩展到向量 gather/scatter 指令，并支持策略范围的覆盖。在 7 个 SPEC CPU 2017 基准上，MallocSan 在其中 5 个优于 Valgrind Memcheck，相对原生执行的几何平均执行时间倍率为 4.82 倍，而 Memcheck 为 18.55 倍，同时在两个评测的多线程负载 644.nab_s 和 pigz 上保持了可观的并行扩展性。在范围内的 Juliet 测试上，MallocSan 检测到所有植入的违例且在良性执行上无误报。它也在真实应用中检测到堆缓冲错误，包括 LibTIFF 的 tiffcrop 工具中已知的一字节 overread。
summary_cn: 提出 MallocSan，一个无需源码、无需重编、无需特殊硬件的 x86-64 Linux 堆 sanitizer，通过 LD_PRELOAD 在指针高位嵌入对象 ID 实现运行时边界检查；在 7 个 SPEC CPU 2017 基准上几何平均开销 4.82 倍（Valgrind Memcheck 为 18.55 倍），并发现了 LibTIFF tiffcrop 中已知的一字节 overread。

title: From Codebase to Culprit (C2C): Reducing the Search Space for Bugs with Semantic Retrieval and Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
title_cn: 从代码库到元凶（C2C）：以语义检索与分层强化学习缩减 bug 搜索空间
abstract: We introduce C2C (From Codebase to Culprit), a framework for precise bug localization that progressively reduces the debugging search space across multiple levels of granularity: files, functions, and lines of code. To mirror developer's natural top-down debugging workflows, C2C integrates semantic retrieval and Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) in a two-stage process. First, it performs recall-oriented retrieval of buggy candidates via semantic vector similarity search using bug-report text, including available stack-trace information, against a database of embeddings, where the embeddings are fine-tuned via contrastive learning with CodeBERT. Building on this reduced search space, the HRL framework incrementally localizes bugs, reasoning from files to functions and ultimately to individual lines of code. Unlike prior approaches which operate at a single granularity, C2C enables multi-resolution localization while maintaining contextual consistency across decisions. Experiments on real-world Java and Python datasets demonstrate that C2C improves retrieval precision and localization accuracy. Ablation studies further highlight the contributions of hierarchical decomposition, structured learning signals, and reward shaping in advancing multi-level bug localization.
abstract_cn: 我们提出 C2C（从代码库到元凶），一个用于精确 bug 定位的框架，它在文件、函数和代码行多个粒度上渐进缩小调试搜索空间。为了契合开发者自然的自顶向下调试流程，C2C 在两阶段过程中整合了语义检索与分层强化学习（HRL）。首先，它基于 bug 报告文本（包括可用的 stack-trace 信息），针对一个嵌入数据库进行语义向量相似度搜索，执行以召回为导向的 buggy 候选检索，其中嵌入通过基于 CodeBERT 的对比学习进行微调。在这个缩减后的搜索空间之上，HRL 框架渐进地定位 bug，从文件推理到函数，最终到单独的代码行。与此前只在单一粒度上操作的方法不同，C2C 支持多分辨率定位，同时在决策之间保持上下文一致性。在真实世界 Java 与 Python 数据集上的实验表明 C2C 提升了检索精度与定位准确率。消融研究进一步突出了分层分解、结构化学习信号与奖励塑形在推进多层级 bug 定位中的贡献。
summary_cn: 提出 C2C 框架，按文件→函数→代码行逐级缩小调试搜索空间：先用对比学习微调的 CodeBERT 嵌入做召回导向的向量检索，再用分层强化学习逐级定位；在真实 Java 与 Python 数据集上检索精度与定位准确率均有提升。
objective_summary: 提出 C2C 框架：先以 CodeBERT 对比学习微调的语义向量检索召回候选，再用层次强化学习逐级定位到文件、函数与代码行。在真实 Java 与 Python 数据集上提升检索精度与定位准确率，消融显示层次分解与奖励塑形有贡献。
evidence_note: Java 与 Python 真实数据集并做消融，摘要未报具体指标数值与基线对比值
novelty_note: 把语义检索与层次 RL 组合做多粒度 bug 定位，跨粒度上下文一致为新点
scope: 结论在 Java 与 Python 真实项目的 bug 定位任务
limitations: 摘要未报具体指标与基线值，规模与统计检验不详

title: OpenCollab: A Multi-Agent Coding Framework with Programmable Collaboration and Controllable Runtime
title_cn: OpenCollab：可编程协作与可控运行时的多 agent 编码框架
abstract: Multi-agent coding systems are designed to tackle complex software engineering tasks through collaboration. However, existing evaluations typically assume configured organizations are followed faithfully, whereas reality differs. This behavioral gap, combined with differences in underlying system components, prevents clear attribution of observed gains. To this end, we introduce OpenCollab, a multi-agent coding framework that provides a unified infrastructure for programmable collaboration and controllable runtime. Specifically, OpenCollab unifies organization design, enforces experimental control on a shared runtime, and tracks execution through fine-grained event streams. On this basis, we define Adherence to quantify whether the declared organization is actually realized. Our experiments reveal that agents collaborate very differently across configurations: changing any single dimension shifts Adherence, from 47.2% to as high as 97.2%. Furthermore, extensive agentic coding benchmarks show that a two-coder workflow built on OpenCollab establishes new SOTA performance compared to the mainstream harnesses such as Mini-SWE-agent, Codex CLI, and Claude Code, showing that a well-designed organization can outperform strong existing harnesses, while OpenCollab's single-agent configuration uses the fewest tokens across all evaluated suites. OpenCollab establishes a unified multi-agent infrastructure for easy programmable collaboration and controlled causal evaluation.
abstract_cn: 多 agent 编码系统旨在通过协作应对复杂的软件工程任务。然而，现有评测通常假定所配置的组织会被忠实遵循，而现实情况有所不同。这种行为上的差距，加上底层系统组件的差异，妨碍了对所观察收益的清晰归因。为此，我们引入 OpenCollab，一个为可编程协作与可控运行时提供统一基础设施的多 agent 编码框架。具体而言，OpenCollab 统一组织设计，在共享运行时上强制执行实验控制，并通过细粒度事件流追踪执行。在此基础上，我们定义 Adherence 以量化所声明的组织是否真正被实现。我们的实验表明，agent 在不同配置下协作方式差异极大：改变任一单一维度即可使 Adherence 从 47.2% 变化到最高 97.2%。此外，大量 agentic coding 基准显示，基于 OpenCollab 构建的双 coder 工作流相较于 Mini-SWE-agent、Codex CLI 和 Claude Code 等主流 harness 建立了新的 SOTA，表明设计良好的组织可以胜过现有强 harness，而 OpenCollab 的单 agent 配置在所有评测套件中使用的 token 最少。OpenCollab 建立了一个统一的多 agent 基础设施，便于可编程协作与受控的因果评测。
summary_cn: 提出 OpenCollab 统一多 agent 编码的组织设计与运行时，并定义 Adherence 衡量声明的组织是否真正被执行；实验显示单维度变动可让 Adherence 在 47.2%–97.2% 间波动，其双 coder 工作流在 agentic coding 基准上超越 Mini-SWE-agent、Codex CLI、Claude Code 等主流 harness，而单 agent 配置 token 开销最小。
objective_summary: 提出 OpenCollab 多代理编码框架，统一组织设计与运行时并定义 Adherence 指标。实验显示单维度切换使 Adherence 从 47.2 升到 97.2，双 coder 工作流在多个编码基准上超过 Mini-SWE-agent、Codex CLI 与 Claude Code。
evidence_note: 对比多主流 harness 并引入 Adherence 定量指标，但未报统计检验与多次运行方差
novelty_note: 把组织设计与运行时解耦，并将执行遵从度量化为可比指标
scope: 结论在主流编码代理基准上，与 Mini-SWE-agent 等 harness 对比
limitations: 作者标注 work on process，缺少方差与多次运行稳定性报告

title: E2E-SWE: Benchmarking LLMs on Building Working Codebases from Scratch
title_cn: E2E-SWE：评测 LLM 从零构建可工作代码库的能力
abstract: Coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are evolving from making localized code changes to developing complete software repositories. However, evaluating repository-scale generation remains challenging: tasks must demand system-level reasoning while ensuring that all evaluated behaviors are precisely specified and independent of any particular implementation. We introduce E2E-SWE, a benchmark for evaluating whether coding agents can build complete, functional software repositories end to end. E2E-SWE contains 186 whole-repository generation tasks spanning 11 programming languages. Given only a natural-language specification and an empty workspace, an agent must implement a complete, installable project that satisfies a comprehensive suite of hidden tests. Each task is constructed by a software engineer in collaboration with an LLM; together, they develop the test suite and a corresponding implementation-independent specification. To ensure that tasks are well specified and practically solvable, we further subject them to an iterative verification process in which autonomous agents audit and repair task defects using static inspection and failures observed from real model rollouts. Evaluating 13 frontier models, we find substantial variation in end-to-end repository generation ability, with pass@1 ranging from 11.7% to 67.7%, providing strong model differentiation while leaving considerable headroom for future progress. Analysis of agent trajectories further reveals long, front-loaded reasoning patterns, highlighting the planning and system-level reasoning required to construct working codebases from scratch.
abstract_cn: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的编码 agent 正从进行局部代码修改演进为开发完整的软件仓库。然而，评测仓库规模的生成仍具挑战性：任务必须要求系统级推理，同时确保所有被评测的行为都被精确规约并独立于任何特定实现。我们引入 E2E-SWE，一个用于评测编码 agent 能否端到端构建完整、可运行软件仓库的基准。E2E-SWE 包含 186 个整仓库生成任务，涵盖 11 种编程语言。给定仅有的自然语言规约与一个空工作区，agent 必须实现一个完整、可安装的项目以满足一套全面的隐藏测试。每个任务由软件工程师与 LLM 协作构建；他们共同开发测试套件和对应的、与实现无关的规约。为确保任务被良好规约且实际可解，我们进一步让任务经过一个迭代验证过程，其中由自主 agent 使用静态检查以及真实模型 rollout 中观察到的失败来审计并修复任务缺陷。评测 13 个前沿模型后，我们发现端到端仓库生成能力存在显著差异，pass@1 从 11.7% 到 67.7%，提供了强模型区分度，同时为未来进展留出可观空间。对 agent 轨迹的分析进一步揭示了长且前置的推理模式，突出构建可工作代码库从零到有所需的规划与系统级推理。
summary_cn: 提出 E2E-SWE 基准，含 11 种语言的 186 个整仓库生成任务；给定自然语言规约与空工作区，agent 需实现可安装项目并通过隐藏测试套件；评测 13 个前沿模型，pass@1 从 11.7% 到 67.7%，并观察到长且前置的推理轨迹。
objective_summary: 构建 E2E-SWE 基准，包含 11 种语言 186 个整仓生成任务，由工程师与 LLM 协作撰写实现无关规格与隐藏测试并经自动审计修复。对 13 个前沿模型评估，pass@1 从 11.7 到 67.7。
evidence_note: 186 任务 11 语言，13 前沿模型评估，有迭代审计修复，但未报统计显著性
novelty_note: 规模与语言覆盖更大，整仓生成基准方向本身已有同期工作
scope: 11 种语言的整仓生成任务，前沿模型 pass@1 11.7-67.7
limitations: 任务由 LLM 协作构造，可能偏向 LLM 更易表达的规格

title: Zero2Repo: Can Coding Agents Build Repositories from Scratch?
title_cn: Zero2Repo：编码 agent 能从零构建仓库吗？
abstract: Coding agents are increasingly asked to build software rather than patch it, yet benchmarks for from-scratch repository construction are mostly limited to a single language and depend on manually curated tasks. We introduce Zero2Repo, a benchmark in which an agent receives a product requirements document, an interface contract, and an empty workspace, and must deliver a complete repository in the project's native ecosystem. Tasks are produced by a language-agnostic authoring pipeline that converts real, version-pinned open-source projects into behavioral specifications, reproducible environments, and hidden acceptance tests. Each task is validated by execution: a reference implementation derived from the upstream project must pass, and adversarial validation must show that the tests reject incorrect implementations. Evaluation runs production coding agents in isolated containers, withholds the acceptance tests until an explicit submission, and assigns a binary reward only when every test passes, with no LLM judge. The pipeline and harness make no language-specific assumptions and apply to mainstream programming ecosystems; the current release contains Python, TypeScript, Go, and C++ tasks. Even on 11 tasks drawn from repositories that frontier models have very likely seen during training, the strongest agent solves only 10, and every failing submission passes 90-99% of the hidden tests; for the two strongest agents, 67-100% of failed tests trace to a single omission or a low-frequency rule stated in the specification rather than to a missing subsystem, so each failure is a concrete target for improvement.
abstract_cn: 编码 agent 越来越被要求构建软件而非只是打补丁，然而针对从零构建仓库的基准大多局限于单一语言并依赖人工构造的任务。我们引入 Zero2Repo，一个让 agent 接收产品需求文档、接口契约与空工作区，并必须以该项目原生生态系统交付完整仓库的基准。任务由一条语言无关的编写流水线生成，该流水线把真实的、版本锁定的开源项目转化为行为规约、可复现环境与隐藏验收测试。每个任务通过执行加以验证：源自上游项目的参考实现必须通过，而对抗验证必须显示测试会拒绝不正确实现。评测在隔离容器中运行生产级编码 agent，在显式提交之前扣留验收测试，且仅在每一个测试通过时赋予二元奖励，不使用 LLM 评判。该流水线与评测架构不作任何语言特定假设，适用于主流编程生态；当前版本包含 Python、TypeScript、Go 与 C++ 任务。即便在 11 个取自前沿模型极可能在训练中见过的仓库的任务上，最强 agent 也只解出 10 个，并且每一个失败的提交都通过了 90–99% 的隐藏测试；对于两个最强 agent，67–100% 的失败测试可追溯到规约中陈述的单一遗漏或低频规则，而非缺失子系统，因此每一次失败都是可改进的具体目标。
summary_cn: 提出 Zero2Repo 基准，用语言无关的流水线把真实版本锁定的开源项目转为行为规约+可复现环境+隐藏验收测试，覆盖 Python/TypeScript/Go/C++；即使在模型大概率训练见过的 11 个任务上最强 agent 也只解 10 个，失败提交通过 90–99% 隐藏测试，67–100% 的失败测试源自单一遗漏或规约中的低频规则。
objective_summary: 提出 Zero2Repo 基准，用语言无关流水线把真实开源项目转为规格、可复现环境与隐藏验收测试，覆盖 Python、TypeScript、Go、C++。11 个训练数据可见任务上最强代理仅解 10 个，失败提交通过 90-99 的隐藏测试。
evidence_note: 11 任务规模较小但覆盖四种生态，含参考实现与对抗验证，二值评分不依赖 LLM 判定
novelty_note: 语言无关的从零建仓基准，并以参考实现加对抗验证保证可解且严格
scope: 当前 11 任务覆盖 Python、TypeScript、Go、C++ 四种生态
limitations: 任务规模小，所选仓库大概率已在训练数据中出现

title: How Should Diffusion Language Models Edit Code?
title_cn: 扩散语言模型该如何编辑代码？
abstract: Code editing requires a model to decide where to make changes, generate the new content, and preserve everything else. We study how masked diffusion language models divide these responsibilities across four editing interfaces: whole-file rewriting, search-and-replace, locate-then-infill, and token-level editing. Experiments on CanItEdit reveal a composition gap: diffusion models can generate coordinated changes when the correct edit locations are supplied, but much of this capability is lost when those locations must be predicted. Access to the intact original code helps the model fill multiple edit regions, yet does not resolve the difficulty of selecting those regions. By varying the editable regions while holding the generation model and decoding procedure fixed, we identify two distinct requirements for successful editing: covering every required change and placing precise boundaries around it. Missing a required region prevents the corresponding change, while widening regions to ensure coverage can sharply reduce success by requiring unchanged code to be regenerated. A sentence-level Wiki editing probe shows the same qualitative gap between supplied and predicted locations beyond code. These findings show why strong infilling capability alone does not ensure reliable editing: the interface must expose all required changes while limiting regeneration of unchanged code.
abstract_cn: 代码编辑要求模型决定在何处修改、生成新内容，并保留其余一切。我们研究 masked 扩散语言模型如何在四种编辑接口上划分这些职责：整文件重写、search-and-replace、locate-then-infill 以及 token 级编辑。在 CanItEdit 上的实验揭示了一个组合缺口：当提供正确的编辑位置时扩散模型能够生成协调一致的修改，但一旦这些位置必须被预测，这种能力就大量丢失。获得完整的原始代码有助于模型填充多个编辑区域，但并不能解决选择这些区域的难题。通过在固定生成模型与解码过程的前提下变动可编辑区域，我们识别出成功编辑的两个不同要求：覆盖每一处必要修改并在其周围放置精确边界。遗漏任一必需区域会阻止对应修改发生，而为了确保覆盖而扩大区域又会由于迫使未变代码被重新生成而大幅降低成功率。一个句子级的 Wiki 编辑探针在代码之外也显示出同样的、关于提供位置与预测位置之间的定性差距。这些发现表明为何单凭强大的 infilling 能力并不能保证可靠编辑：接口必须暴露所有必需修改，同时限制未变代码的再生。
summary_cn: 系统比较四种编辑接口（整文件重写、search-and-replace、locate-then-infill、token 级编辑）下 masked diffusion 模型的表现，在 CanItEdit 上揭示组合缺口：给定正确编辑位置时模型能生成协调修改，一旦位置需预测则能力大幅下滑；成功编辑需同时覆盖所有必要修改且精确限定边界。
objective_summary: 在 CanItEdit 上固定扩散生成模型与解码，比较全文件重写、搜索替换、定位填补、token 级编辑四种接口。发现扩散语言模型在给定编辑位置时能协调多处修改，但需自预测位置时成功率大幅下降。
evidence_note: CanItEdit 代码基准加句子级 Wiki 探针，变换接口做消融但未报统计检验
novelty_note: 把扩散模型编辑分解为覆盖与边界两要素，指出接口而非生成是瓶颈
scope: 限于掩码扩散模型在 CanItEdit 与 Wiki 句子级编辑
limitations: 固定一种生成模型与解码过程，未覆盖自回归模型与大规模仓库编辑

title: TomasuLLM: Out-of-Order Speculative Execution for LLM Agents
title_cn: TomasuLLM：面向 LLM agent 的乱序推测执行
abstract: Long-running tools can dominate coding-agent latency: compilers, test suites, and repository commands take seconds to minutes while the agent idles. This observation stall presents the same tension that drove out-of-order processors -- asequential interface hides work that can be predicted and started early, but a speculative result may become visible only after it and every earlier step have been validated. We present TomasuLLM, a runtime that executes agent tool calls out of trajectory order while preserving task-execution correctness. It drafts future actions, runs them in isolated copy-on-write sandboxes, traces their dependencies and effects, and commits results in trajectory order only after validation against committed state. Across three benchmarks spanning sub-second to minutes-long tool calls, TomasuLLM improves the reported benchmark means and scales with tool latency: 1.31x on 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks, 1.35x on 28 Terminal-Bench 2.0 tasks, and 1.27x matched progress on 18 SWE-Marathon sessions. Across 4,010 audited commit-validation records, it produces zero false accepts.
abstract_cn: 长时间运行的工具会主导编程 agent 的延迟：编译器、测试套件和仓库命令要花数秒到数分钟，而 agent 处于空闲状态。这种观察到的停顿呈现出与推动乱序处理器（out-of-order processor）相同的张力——顺序接口隐藏了可以被预测并提前启动的工作，但推测结果只有在它自身以及之前的每一步都通过验证后才可对外可见。我们提出 TomasuLLM，一个按非轨迹顺序执行 agent 工具调用、同时保持任务执行正确性的运行时。它预测后续动作，在隔离的写时复制沙箱中运行它们，追踪其依赖与副作用，并在通过对已提交状态的验证后，按轨迹顺序提交结果。在覆盖亚秒到数分钟量级工具调用的三个基准上，TomasuLLM 改进了所报告的基准均值，并随工具延迟而扩展：在 100 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务上取得 1.31 倍提升，在 28 个 Terminal-Bench 2.0 任务上取得 1.35 倍，在 18 个 SWE-Marathon 会话上取得 1.27 倍匹配进度。在 4,010 条审计过的提交验证记录中，它产生了零次错误接受。
summary_cn: TomasuLLM 把乱序处理器思想搬到 agent 工具调用上：在写时复制沙箱里预跑后续动作、追踪依赖、按轨迹顺序提交；SWE-bench Verified 100 任务 1.31 倍、Terminal-Bench 2.0 28 任务 1.35 倍、SWE-Marathon 18 会话 1.27 倍，4,010 条验证记录零错误接受。
objective_summary: 提出 TomasuLLM 运行时，在隔离的写时复制沙盒中乱序推测执行代理工具调用并按轨迹顺序提交。在 100 个 SWE-bench Verified、28 个 Terminal-Bench 2.0 与 18 个 SWE-Marathon 会话上分别取得 1.31、1.35、1.27 倍提升，4010 条提交审核零误接受。
evidence_note: 三个基准共百余任务有延迟对照，4010 次提交验证零误接受，但未报方差与统计检验
novelty_note: 将 CPU 乱序推测执行思路迁移到 LLM 代理工具调用，并给出提交期一致性协议
scope: 结论限于三个 SWE 基准上含长耗时工具调用的编码代理任务
limitations: 收益依赖工具延迟长度与依赖追踪精度，摘要未报方差
